Estimated from the photo, the tray holds: 2 slices of toasted bread (about 120 kcal), a few avocado slices (about 60 kcal), a strawberry yoghurt pot of about 125 g (about 110 kcal), a bowl of peach slices (about 70 kcal), a glass of juice or squash (about 50 kcal), and tea with milk (about 25 kcal).

Served total: 120 + 60 + 110 + 70 + 50 + 25 = 435 kcal.

The photo is taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left. I assumed a small amount of leftover, about 30 kcal.

Eaten: 435 − 30 = 405 kcal.

Macronutrients for the eaten portion (rough sums from the items above):
- Protein: bread 4 g, avocado 1 g, yoghurt 5 g, peaches 1 g, milk in tea 1 g, so about 12 g.
- Carbohydrate: bread 22 g, avocado 3 g, yoghurt 18 g, peaches 17 g, juice 12 g, so about 72 g.
- Fat: bread 3 g, avocado 5 g, yoghurt 3 g, so about 11 g.
